description: This file defines the MetaResponse class, which implements JsonSerializable to provide a flexible response object that can hold arbitrary properties, typically used to represent metadata in a JSON API response.

classes.name: MetaResponse
classes.description: A class representing a dynamic metadata response structure that can serialize itself to JSON and allows dynamic property setting and getting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MetaResponse instance with properties passed as an array or stdClass, with validation.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Retrieves a property value by name from the properties array.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Sets a property value by name in the properties array.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Returns the properties array for JSON serialization.
